title: [v0.92][WP-13][defect] Anchor cognitive-profile authority and verify full revision lineage
body:

- Public serialization/fail-closed boundary: 1/1 passed
- External authority establishment compile-fail: 1/1 passed
- Strict library Clippy, formatting, evidence hashes, and path hygiene passed
- Both corrective and merged generic WP-13 producer/validator pairs pass syntax and self-tests and now require the same exact filtered 15-test inventory while retaining distinct issue/workflow/evidence/provenance bindings
